title: Murmora
description: A dark ambient horror mod that adds unsettling custom sounds to make your Minecraft world feel haunted, watched, and alive.
body:
# Murmora

**Murmora** is a dark ambient horror mod focused on unsettling sound design.

It adds a collection of creepy custom sounds made to create tension, paranoia, and supernatural atmosphere in Minecraft. From distant knocks to eerie musical boxes and disturbing whispers, Murmora is designed for horror servers, roleplay worlds, survival experiences, and atmospheric modpacks.

## Features

- Custom horror ambience sounds
- Creepy door knocking sound
- Music box sound for unsettling scenes
- Whisper-like and breathing sounds
- Screamer-style growl sound
- Lightweight and simple to use
- Great for horror maps, roleplay servers, and survival horror setups

## Included Sounds

- Door knocking
- Music box
- Distant lament
- Sigh / breath
- Screamer growl

## Recommended Use

Murmora works best in horror-themed worlds, abandoned buildings, haunted mansions, dark forests, underground areas, and roleplay servers where atmosphere matters.

This mod does not try to flood your game with noise. It is made to create moments where players stop, listen, and ask:

*"Did someone else hear that?"*
